fullPassage:
A Trip to the Netherlands

Before my trip to the Netherlands, all I knew of the country was that it is famous for windmills and tulips. But as I cycled from place to place, I experienced many things that I hadn't expected, and I wanted to share some of them with you.

"The Anne Frank House and the Prinsengracht in Amsterdam"

My first stop was the Anne Frank House, one of the old buildings lined up along the Prinsengracht, a canal in Amsterdam. Since it was close to the hotel I was staying at, I decided to rent a bike to go there. I enjoyed riding along the canal. The Anne Frank House is one of the most visited museums in the Netherlands. It housed the secret hiding place of Anne Frank.

There was an old bookcase on the second floor. It looked ordinary, but behind it was a secret space where Anne and her family hid for over two years during World War II. The steep stairs and narrow passages gave me a better understanding of what life must have been like for them back then.

After visiting the Anne Frank House, I took a canal cruise on the Prinsengracht. The canal houses I saw along the way had mostly been built during the Dutch Golden Age, which gives them great historical value. Taking the cruise was a great way to see the city from different angles. The gentle touch of the wind made the experience even more pleasant.

"The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam"

Amsterdam is home to a lot of museums, but the Van Gogh Museum was the one I was really excited to visit. The most interesting part of the museum was the way the exhibits were arranged to show how the artist's style had changed over time. The museum showed many of Vincent van Gogh's most well-known works, including my personal favorites: The Bedroom, Sunflowers, and Wheatfield with Crows. The bright colors in The Bedroom seemed to convey a sense of relaxation. The different shades of yellow in Sunflowers were just amazing. In Wheatfield with Crows, the contrast between the bright yellow wheat field and the cool blue sky was striking. Overall, seeing the artworks in person was a very powerful experience.

The museum also displayed the letters that Van Gogh wrote to his younger brother, Theo. Reading those letters, I found out how much the artist loved his brother. After I bought a few postcards with Van Gogh's art on them, I slowly cycled back to the hotel. On my way back, I couldn't help but admire the beautiful, calm, and scenic views of the city, especially people relaxing on the grass and enjoying the sun.

"Windmills in the Zaanse Schans and Seafood in Volendam"

I highly recommend visiting the Zaanse Schans and Volendam if you want to get out of the busy city to experience traditional Dutch culture. A trip to the Netherlands wouldn't be complete without a visit to the windmills. Fortunately, you can get to the Zaanse Schans, which is famous for its windmills, in just 17 minutes by train from Amsterdam.

The moment I saw the village, its beauty took my breath away. Several windmills were spinning by the river in the distance. Soon I felt like I was taken to a point in the past. I looked into one of the working windmills, and it was grinding nuts into oil with its large stone wheels.

Near the windmills, I found a cheese farm and a clog factory. I was surprised by the variety of Dutch cheeses and actually a little unsure about tasting them at first because they were mostly new to me. However, when I tried some of them, they turned out to be incredibly satisfying. I also tried on a few pairs of clogs and found them quite comfortable, which I hadn't expected.

Volendam was a pretty fishing village with neat rows of brick houses with orange roofs. The harbor was dotted with boats. I rented a bike to explore Volendam, and the shop owner said, "In Volendam, do as the locals do and eat seafood." At a restaurant, I ordered one of the Netherlands' most popular dishes, kibbeling. The fried fish snack was hot, fresh, and absolutely delicious!

"The Cube Houses in Rotterdam"

After being completely destroyed during World War II, Rotterdam was restored into a beautiful port city. Experimental and artistic constructions were used to improve the appearance of the city. The Cube Houses in Rotterdam are among the most innovative buildings in the country. The bright yellow houses were something I had been looking forward to seeing, and they were as fantastic as I had expected.

One of the key features of the Cube Houses is that the cubes are tilted by 45 degrees. I visited the Show Cube Museum to get a feel of what life in such a house was like. From the outside, it looked entirely twisted, but once I went inside, it was surprisingly quite comfortable.

For the last few days after the trip, I haven't been able to get the charming sights of the Netherlands out of my mind. If you ever plan to visit the country, I really hope that you will find my post helpful.

Q&A: Are Dutch clogs comfortable?

@Olivia: I wonder if Dutch wooden shoes are comfortable. What do YOU think?

@Liam: I have worn Dutch clogs, and I have to admit they are rather comfortable and useful as well. The wood keeps my feet dry. It easily absorbs sweat and allows the feet to breathe. The wood also provides good support and protects the feet. So they are perfect for activities like gardening, farming, and walking in muddy areas.

@Katie: I tried wearing clogs during a visit to the Netherlands, and I found them uncomfortable. The wood was hard and inflexible, and my feet started to hurt after a while.

@Jacob: After they're worn frequently, or if you wear thick socks, they'll become more comfortable.

@Ashley: I have never worn clogs, but I believe they are probably comfortable for people who are used to them. Clogs have long been a part of Dutch culture, especially in rural regions, and I'd love to try a pair someday.

@Ethan: I purchased a pair of Dutch clogs during my trip to the Netherlands, and I have to say they are not the most comfortable shoes. However, they do look very pretty and unique.

det.tip: be dotted with: ~이 점점이 흩어져 있다. variety: 다양함. scarcity: 부족함, 희소성.

det.korean: 2층 책장은 평범해 보였지만 비밀 공간이 있었다. 가파른 계단과 좁은 통로가 이해를 도왔다. 유람선은 도시를 다른 각도(angles)에서 볼 수 있는 좋은 방법이었다.

det.tip: angles(각도, 시각) vs distances(거리): 유람선에서 도시를 '다른 시각'으로 보는 것이 적절.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 반 고흐의 유명한 작품들을 보여주었다. 편지를 읽으며 예술가가 동생을 사랑했음을 알게 되었다. 돌아가며 아름답고 차분한 경치 좋은(scenic) 도시 풍경에 감탄했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①well-known(잘 알려진): 원문 그대로. ✅ ②loved(사랑했다): 원문 그대로. ✅ ③admire(감탄하다): 원문 그대로. ❌ ④chaotic(혼란스러운): 원문은 scenic(경치 좋은). beautiful, calm과 병렬이므로 chaotic은 부적절.
det.tip: scenic(경치 좋은) ↔ chaotic(혼란스러운). beautiful, calm과 나란히 쓰인 형용사는 긍정적이어야 한다.

questions.passage: After being completely destroyed during World War II, Rotterdam was ①<u>restored</u> into a beautiful port city. ②<u>Experimental</u> and artistic constructions were used to improve the appearance of the city. One of the key features of the Cube Houses is that the cubes are ③<u>tilted</u> by 45 degrees. From the outside, it looked entirely twisted, but once I went inside, it was surprisingly quite ④<u>cramped</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 로테르담은 2차 대전 후 아름다운 항구 도시로 복원되었다. 실험적이고 예술적인 건축 양식이 사용되었다. 큐브가 45도로 기울어져 있다. 밖에서는 완전히 뒤틀려 보였지만 안은 놀랍게도 아늑했다(comfortable).
det.analysis: ✅ ①restored(복원된): 원문 그대로. ✅ ②Experimental(실험적인): 원문 그대로. ✅ ③tilted(기울어진): 원문 그대로. ❌ ④cramped(비좁은): 원문은 comfortable(아늑한). 'surprisingly quite'와 함께 긍정적 반전을 나타내므로 cramped는 부적절.
det.tip: comfortable(편안한, 아늑한) ↔ cramped(비좁은). 'surprisingly'는 예상과 다른 긍정적 결과를 나타냄.

det.korean: 안네 프랑크 하우스를 방문한 후 프린센흐라흐트에서 유람선을 탔다. 운하의 집들은 네덜란드 황금시대에 지어져 역사적 가치가 크다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③historical: '역사적 가치'. 황금시대에 지어졌으므로 역사적 가치가 적절. ❌ ①commercial(상업적): 상업적 가치는 문맥 불일치. ❌ ②sentimental(감상적): 감상적 가치도 맥락과 맞지 않음. ❌ ④educational(교육적): 가능하나 원문은 historical.
det.tip: historical value: 역사적 가치. Dutch Golden Age(네덜란드 황금시대)는 17세기 네덜란드 전성기.

The most interesting part of the museum was the way the exhibits were arranged to show how the artist's style had changed over time. The bright colors in The Bedroom seemed to convey a sense of __________. The different shades of yellow in Sunflowers were just amazing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 반 고흐 미술관은 방문하게 되어 정말 설렜다. 전시물 배치가 흥미로웠다. '침실'의 밝은 색상이 편안함의 느낌을 전달했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④relaxation: 원문 그대로 'a sense of relaxation'. ❌ ①tension(긴장): 밝은 색상과 반대. ❌ ②mystery(신비): 가능하나 원문과 불일치. ❌ ③adventure(모험): 침실 그림의 밝은 색과 무관.
det.tip: relaxation: 편안함, 휴식. '침실'이라는 주제와 밝은 색상이 주는 편안한 느낌.

questions.passage: The moment I saw the village, its beauty took my breath away. Several windmills were spinning by the river in the distance. Soon I felt like I was taken to a point in the past. I looked into one of the working windmills, and it was __________ nuts into oil with its large stone wheels.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마을의 아름다움에 숨이 멎었다. 풍차가 돌고 있었다. 작동하는 풍차를 들여다보니 큰 돌바퀴로 견과를 갈아서 기름을 만들고 있었다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②grinding: '갈다'. 돌바퀴로 견과를 갈아 기름을 만듦. ❌ ①pressing(누르다): 가능하나 'with stone wheels'와 grinding이 더 적절. ❌ ③pouring(붓다): 물리적 과정과 불일치. ❌ ④melting(녹이다): 견과를 녹이는 것은 부자연스러움.
det.tip: grind: (곡식 등을) 갈다, 빻다. grind-ground-ground. 풍차의 전통적 용도.

questions.passage: I highly recommend visiting the Zaanse Schans and Volendam if you want to get out of the busy city to experience traditional Dutch culture. A trip to the Netherlands wouldn't be <u>complete</u> without a visit to the windmills.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'complete'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 잔서스한스와 폴렌담 방문을 강력히 추천한다. 풍차 방문이 빠지면 여행은 완전하지 않을 것이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①whole: complete(완전한)와 동의어. ❌ ②complex(복잡한): 의미 무관. ❌ ③separate(분리된): 반대. ❌ ④ordinary(평범한): 무관.
det.tip: complete ≈ whole: 완전한, 온전한. 'wouldn't be complete without' = '~없이는 완전하지 않다'.

questions.passage: The Cube Houses in Rotterdam are among the most <u>innovative</u> buildings in the country. The bright yellow houses were something I had been looking forward to seeing.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'innovative'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 로테르담의 큐브 하우스는 그 나라에서 가장 혁신적인 건물에 속한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③creative: innovative(혁신적인)와 가장 가까운 동의어. ❌ ①traditional(전통적인): 반의어. ❌ ②expensive(비싼): 무관. ❌ ④dangerous(위험한): 무관.
det.tip: innovative ≈ creative: 혁신적인, 창의적인. 새로운 아이디어나 방법을 도입한 것.

questions.passage: I was surprised by the variety of Dutch cheeses and actually a little unsure about tasting them at first because they were mostly new to me. However, when I tried some of them, they turned out to be incredibly <u>satisfying</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'satisfying'과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 네덜란드 치즈의 다양함에 놀랐다. 처음엔 확신이 없었지만 먹어보니 믿을 수 없을 정도로 만족스러웠다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②pleasing: satisfying(만족스러운)과 동의어. ❌ ①surprising(놀라운): 만족과 다른 감정. ❌ ③confusing(혼란스러운): 반대 뉘앙스. ❌ ④demanding(힘든): 반대 의미.
det.tip: satisfying ≈ pleasing: 만족스러운, 기분 좋은. '기대 이상으로 좋았다'는 맥락.

questions.passage: The wood was hard and <u>inflexible</u>, and my feet started to hurt after a while.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'inflexible'과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 나무가 딱딱하고 유연하지 않아서 발이 아프기 시작했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④bendable: inflexible(유연하지 않은)의 반의어. 구부릴 수 있는. ❌ ①rigid(딱딱한): 동의어. ❌ ②stiff(뻣뻣한): 동의어. ❌ ③firm(단단한): 동의어.
det.tip: inflexible(유연하지 않은) ↔ bendable(구부릴 수 있는). rigid, stiff, firm은 모두 inflexible과 비슷한 의미.

questions.passage: For the last few days after the trip, I haven't been able to get the <u>charming</u> sights of the Netherlands out of my mind.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 'charming'과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 여행 후 며칠간 네덜란드의 매력적인 광경을 잊을 수 없었다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③repulsive: charming(매력적인)의 반의어. 불쾌한, 혐오스러운. ❌ ①attractive(매력적인): 동의어. ❌ ②delightful(기분 좋은): 동의어. ❌ ④appealing(매력적인): 동의어.
det.tip: charming(매력적인) ↔ repulsive(불쾌한, 혐오스러운). attractive, delightful, appealing은 모두 charming과 유사어.

It <u>housed</u> the secret hiding place of Anne Frank.

questions.stem: (A)의 'housed'와 (B)의 'houses'의 의미를 가장 잘 나타낸 것은?

det.korean: (A) 그곳은 안네 프랑크의 비밀 은신처를 보관하고 있었다. (B) 폴렌담은 오렌지 지붕의 벽돌 주택들이 줄지어 있었다.
det.analysis: ✅ ② (A) housed=보관하다: 건물이 무엇을 '수용/보관하다'. (B) houses=주택들: 일반 명사. ❌ ① (A)집을 제공하다: 사람에게 주거를 제공하는 뜻은 여기서 맞지 않음. ❌ ③ (A)숨기다: house에 '숨기다' 뜻은 없음. ❌ ④ (A)전시하다: display와 혼동.
det.tip: house(동사): 수용하다, 보관하다. house(명사): 집, 주택. 같은 단어의 품사 변환.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the outer form or look of someone or something"

det.korean: "누군가 또는 무엇의 외적 형태나 모습"
det.analysis: ✅ ③appearance: 외모, 외관. 정의와 정확히 일치. 본문 'improve the appearance of the city'. ❌ ①construction(건축): 짓는 행위. ❌ ②experiment(실험): 무관. ❌ ④atmosphere(분위기): 외형이 아닌 느낌.
det.tip: appearance: 외모, 겉모습. 본문에서 '도시의 외관을 개선하기 위해' 사용됨.

questions.passage: I was surprised by the variety of Dutch cheeses and actually a little unsure about tasting them at first because they were mostly new to me. However, when I tried some of them, they turned out to be incredibly satisfying.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

The __________ (vary) of food options at the market amazed all the visitors.

det.korean: 시장의 음식 선택지의 다양함이 모든 방문객을 놀라게 했다.
det.analysis: ✅ variety: 관사 The 뒤이므로 명사 형태. vary(동사) → variety(명사).
det.tip: vary(동사: 다양하다) → variety(명사: 다양함). various(형용사: 다양한)와 구분.

questions.passage: After being completely destroyed during World War II, Rotterdam was restored into a beautiful port city. Experimental and artistic constructions were used to improve the appearance of the city.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

The scientists conducted an __________ (experiment) to test the new theory.

det.korean: 과학자들은 새로운 이론을 시험하기 위해 실험을 수행했다.
det.analysis: ✅ experiment: 관사 an 뒤이므로 명사 형태. experiment(명사: 실험). 형용사 experimental과 구분.
det.tip: experiment(명사: 실험) vs experimental(형용사: 실험적인). 'conduct an experiment' = '실험을 수행하다'.

questions.passage: The moment I saw the village, its beauty took my breath away. Several windmills were spinning by the river in the distance. Soon I felt like I was taken to a point in the past. I looked into one of the working windmills, and it was grinding nuts into oil with its large stone wheels. Near the windmills, I found a cheese farm and a __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 풍차 마을의 아름다움에 숨이 멎었다. 풍차가 견과를 갈아 기름을 만들고 있었다. 풍차 근처에서 치즈 농가와 나막신 공장을 발견했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②clog factory: 원문 그대로 'a cheese farm and a clog factory'. ❌ ①bicycle shop(자전거 가게): 풍차 마을과 무관. ❌ ③flower market(꽃 시장): 튤립은 유명하나 이 마을에서 언급 없음. ❌ ④souvenir store(기념품 가게): 원문에 없음.
det.tip: clog: 나막신. 나무로 만든 네덜란드 전통 신발. factory: 공장.

questions.passage: I have worn Dutch clogs, and I have to admit they are rather comfortable and useful as well. The wood keeps my feet dry. It easily absorbs sweat and allows the feet to breathe. The wood also provides good support and protects the feet. So they are perfect for activities like gardening, farming, and __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 나막신은 편안하고 유용하다. 나무가 발을 마르게 하고, 땀을 흡수하고, 숨쉬게 하고, 지지력을 주고 보호한다. 정원 가꾸기, 농사, 그리고 진흙 지역 걷기에 완벽하다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④walking in muddy areas: 원문 그대로. 나막신이 발을 건조하게 유지하므로 진흙 지역 걷기에 적합. ❌ ①running on a track(트랙 달리기): 나막신과 어울리지 않음. ❌ ②swimming in a pool(수영): 신발과 무관. ❌ ③climbing a mountain(등산): 나막신으로는 부적합.
det.tip: gardening, farming, walking in muddy areas: 모두 야외·농촌 활동. 나막신의 방수·보호 기능과 연결.
